goal: Extract the nested interface RandomAccessResourceBridge into a top-level interface to reduce Tailer size and separate the random-access contract.

ops.details: Create a new top-level interface RandomAccessResourceBridge in package org.apache.commons.io.input with the same method signatures (close, getPointer, read, seek). Remove the nested interface declaration from Tailer.java. Keep package-private visibility identical to the original (public interface remains public).
Add required imports to the new top-level interface file (java.io.Closeable, java.io.IOException) to make it independently compilable.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
